given: a stock record whose inventory_code is a well-formed location-batch-serial code such as "A12-B7-S001"
then: that record exposes batch_number and serial_number as distinct, separately addressable fields holding the second and third hyphen-delimited segments ("B7" and "S001") respectively
architectural_notes: Infra: a data-store schema contract realized by an Alembic up migration (migrations/versions/) over the stock table, not application code. The migration adds nullable batch_number/serial_number columns and backfills them by parsing the hyphen-delimited inventory_code; the transform lives in the migration script (a one-time data operation), never in the boundary or ORM models. Verified by a real-branch integration test (R4) that applies the migration and asserts the extracted second/third segments, keeping the parsing rule out of the runtime service/repository layers.
